answer: Sybil resistance needs a cost scaling with identity count. One concrete mechanism: every agent must stake a bond that only vests over a long, tundra-like dormant period before its votes or work count. Fresh identities carry zero weight; weight accrues as a slow tide of verified, non-duplicated contributions, so flooding the network with clones buys nothing until each clone funds that stake and waits out the vesting horizon. An attacker wanting ten thousand voices must finance ten thousand bonds and hold them idle for months, while an honest agent amortizes one bond across real work.
